title: Inside the house: furniture and things
intro: Read plate 1 alongside this unit, which names the rooms. These are the things inside them. Note that Spanish says la luz for both the light and the electricity.

entries.note: los muebles is furniture collectively. English has no singular for it; Spanish does.

ex.es: Compramos los muebles de segunda mano.
ex.en: We bought the furniture second-hand.

entries.note: hacer la cama is to make the bed; irse a la cama to go to bed.

ex.en: The bed is too soft.

entries.note: la sábana is a sheet; la manta or la cobija a blanket.

ex.en: I need another pillow.

entries.note: el sofá is the sofa, and is masculine despite the -a.

ex.es: Se quedó dormido en el sillón.
ex.en: He fell asleep in the armchair.

entries.note: el clóset in much of Latin America; el ropero for clothes specifically.

ex.es: Cuelga la camisa en el armario.
ex.en: Hang the shirt in the wardrobe.

entries.note: Plural cajones. la caja is a box, and also the till in a shop.

ex.es: Las llaves están en el primer cajón.
ex.en: The keys are in the top drawer.

entries.note: la estantería is the whole bookcase; el librero too in Mexico.

ex.es: Puse los libros en el estante de arriba.
ex.en: I put the books on the top shelf.

ex.es: Enciende la lámpara, no veo nada.
ex.en: Turn the lamp on, I can't see a thing.

entries.note: Plural luces. Se fue la luz means the power went out.

ex.en: Turn the light off when you leave.

ex.es: Se fue la luz en todo el barrio.
ex.en: The power went out in the whole neighbourhood.
She looked at herself in the mirror.
The rug is stained.
Open the curtains, the sun's coming in.

entries.note: In Spain un piso is also a flat. el suelo is the ground or floor surface.

ex.en: The floor is wet.
We live on the third floor.

entries.note: Often plural for stairs: las escaleras.

ex.en: We went up the stairs.

ex.es: Trae la escalera para el techo.
ex.en: Bring the ladder for the ceiling.

entries.note: In Spain the tap is el grifo; llave de agua in Latin America.

ex.en: I left the keys inside.
Turn the tap off properly.

entries.note: la toalla is a towel; el cepillo de dientes a toothbrush.

ex.en: We're out of soap.

entries.note: sacar la basura is to take the rubbish out.

ex.en: Throw that in the bin.
The bin is full.

entries.note: hacer la limpieza is to do the cleaning; barrer to sweep.

ex.en: I clean the kitchen on Sundays.

entries.note: Reflexive lavarse for washing yourself: me lavo las manos.

ex.en: The dishes need washing.
This armchair is very comfortable.

ex.es: Es más cómodo pagar en línea.
ex.en: It's more convenient to pay online.
